from pathlib import Path
import json, math, platform, subprocess, sys, time, warnings
from importlib.metadata import version
from unittest.mock import patch

from deap.tools import cxSimulatedBinaryBounded
from sklearn.datasets import load_diabetes, load_wine, load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge, LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import get_scorer
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn_genetic import GASearchCV
from sklearn_genetic.space import Continuous
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

def log_mate(self, first, second):
    dim = self.space[self.space.parameters[0]]
    before = [math.log(first[0]), math.log(second[0])]
    a, b = cxSimulatedBinaryBounded([before[0]], [before[1]], eta=10,
                                   low=math.log(dim.lower), up=math.log(dim.upper))
    for individual, allele, original in zip((first, second), (a[0], b[0]), before):
        if allele != original:
            individual[0] = math.exp(allele)
        self._repair_individual(individual)
    return first, second

def run():
    rows=[]
    tasks=[("Diabetes",load_diabetes,Ridge(),"ridge__alpha",1e-4,1e4,"neg_mean_squared_error"),
           ("Wine",load_wine,LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000),"logisticregression__C",1e-4,1e4,"accuracy"),
           ("Breast Cancer",load_breast_cancer,SVC(),"svc__gamma",1e-6,1e1,"balanced_accuracy")]
    with threadpool_limits(1):
        for name,load,model,param,lower,upper,metric in tasks:
            X,y=load(return_X_y=True)
            for seed in (1301,1302,1303):
                classification = name != "Diabetes"
                train,test=train_test_split(range(len(y)),test_size=.25,random_state=seed,
                                            stratify=y if classification else None)
                cv=(StratifiedKFold if classification else KFold)(3,shuffle=True,random_state=seed)
                folds=list(cv.split(X[train],y[train]))
                initial=None
                for method in (["linear","log"] if seed%2 else ["log","linear"]):
                    with patch.object(GASearchCV,"mate",log_mate if method=="log" else GASearchCV.mate):
                        search=GASearchCV(make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),model),param_grid={
                            param:Continuous(lower,upper,distribution="log-uniform")},
                            population_size=6,generations=2,cv=folds,n_jobs=1,random_state=seed,
                            scoring=metric,verbose=False,error_score="raise")
                        start=time.perf_counter()
                        search.fit(X[train],y[train])
                        seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
                    first=list(search.cv_results_["params"][:6])
                    assert initial is None or initial==first
                    initial=first
                    rows.append(dict(task=name,seed=seed,method=method,cv=float(search.best_score_),
                                     holdout=float(get_scorer(metric)(search.best_estimator_,X[test],y[test])),
                                     metric=metric,params=search.best_params_,seconds=seconds,
                                     candidates=search.fit_stats_["cross_validate_calls"],
                                     proposals=search.fit_stats_["evaluated_candidates"]))
    return rows

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.filterwarnings("ignore",message="Warning, only one parameter was provided.*")
    rows=run()
result=dict(source_commit=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),
            python=platform.python_version(),versions={p:version(p) for p in ("numpy","scipy","deap","scikit-learn")},
            rows=rows,reproduction_script=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,allow_nan=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
